value.en: They believed that property values would always rise, houses would always become more expensive.
value.zh: 他们坚信房地产价值永远会上涨，房子只会越来越贵。

value.en: The NASDAQ Stock Index, which included many tech companies, lost nearly 80% of its value.
value.zh: 纳斯达克股票指数包含了许多科技公司，其价值损失了近80%。

value.en: If you take something for granted, you fail to value or appreciate something which benefits you.
value.zh: 如果你把某事视为理所当然，你就会忽视或不感激对你有益的事情。

value.en: That has real value, especially if you don't have many opportunities to practise with real people.
value.zh: 这具有真正的价值，特别是如果你没有太多机会与真人练习的话。

value.en: And then you start seeing, wow, the property values have stopped increasing.
value.zh: 然后你开始发现，哇，房产价值已经停止上涨了。

vanish.en: The generous young emperor, the son of Germanicus, the darling of Rome, seemed to vanish.
vanish.zh: 那个慷慨的年轻皇帝、Germanicus 的儿子、罗马的宠儿，似乎消失了。

vanish.en: It vanishes into the air. A product which is on the market is available for people to buy.
vanish.zh: 它消散在空气中。一个“在市场上”的产品是指人们可以购买到的产品。

vanish.en: The Arab kingdom Lawrence had fought for vanished almost immediately.
vanish.zh: Lawrence 为之奋斗的阿拉伯王国几乎立即消失了。

vanish.en: A few spin wilder theories: that Fawcett discovered Z, decided to stay, and purposefully vanished from Western civilisation.
vanish.zh: 还有少数人脑洞大开：认为 Fawcett 找到了 Z，决定留下来，并故意从西方文明中隐匿了。

vanish.en: Lucan’s car was found abandoned, spattered with blood, but the man himself seemed to have vanished into thin air.
vanish.zh: Lucan 的车被发现遗弃在路边，车上血迹斑斑，但他本人却似乎人间蒸发了。

variety.en: Impressed by his notebooks, Ramanujan was introduced to a variety of other prominent mathematicians.
variety.zh: Ramaswamy对他的笔记本印象深刻，于是把Ramanujan介绍给了其他几位杰出的数学家。

variety.en: Yes, Beth. I asked you which variety of garlic grew in the former USSR.
variety.zh: 是的，贝丝。我问过你哪种大蒜品种生长在前苏联。

variety.en: So, which of the following varieties of garlic grew in the former USSR?
variety.zh: 那么，以下哪种大蒜品种生长在前苏联？

variety.en: Teachers are pretty good at comprehending a variety of different accents and also interpreting your mistakes.
variety.zh: 老师非常擅长理解各种不同的口音，也能解读你的错误。

variety.en: Like other crops, rice has varieties – different types, for example brown rice, long-grained rice or basmati.
variety.zh: 与其他作物一样，水稻也有各种品种——不同的类型，例如糙米、长粒米或巴斯马蒂香米。

valid.en: What does that mean? A valid environment is one that has rules, patterns, and consistency.
valid.zh: 这是什么意思？一个有效的环境是指具有规则、模式和一致性的环境。

valid.en: Of course, it’s complex, and sometimes it feels irregular, but it’s still a valid learning environment.
valid.zh: 当然，它很复杂，有时感觉不规则，但它仍然是一个有效的学习环境。

valid.en: The way I see the world might be different from somebody else, but that's valid.
valid.zh: 我看世界的方式可能和别人不同，但那也是有道理的。

valid.en: For an experiment to be scientifically valid, it needs to be carefully controlled, with clear instructions and procedures.
valid.zh: 一项实验要具备科学有效性，就需要经过严谨的控制，有清晰的指令和流程。

valid.en: But the more important criticism was about what the findings actually meant, and whether the experiment was valid at all.
valid.zh: 但更重要的质疑，在于这些结果究竟意味着什么，以及这项实验是否真的有效。

various.en: Instead, there were various different city states, regions, and kingdoms across the area.
various.zh: 相反，该地区有各种不同的城邦、地区和王国。

various.en: The centuries of attacks from various different empires and armies significantly weakened Constantinople.
various.zh: 来自各个不同帝国和军队的数百年攻击大大削弱了君士坦丁堡。

various.en: The idiom this and that can be used to describe various unspecified things.
various.zh: 习语“这啊那的”可以用来描述各种未指明的事情。

various.en: You’ll know this if you’ve listened to my previous episodes on the history of various cities.
various.zh: 如果你听过我先前关于各大城市历史的节目，你就会知道这一点。

various.en: He had suggested, at various points, that Jesus Christ was an impostor.
various.zh: 他在不同场合暗示耶稣基督是个骗子。

vary.en: Yet people vary widely in their ability to identify, understand and manage emotional signals.
vary.zh: 然而，人们在识别、理解和管理情绪信号的能力上，却存在很大差异。

vary.en: Another significant challenge is that asteroids typically rotate, often unpredictably and at varying speeds.
vary.zh: 另一个重大挑战是小行星通常会旋转，而且往往是毫无规律地以不同的速度旋转。

vary.en: My ability in Japanese is pretty good, but my performance can vary wildly.
vary.zh: 我的日语能力相当不错，但我的表现却可能起伏不定。

vary.en: Even within the same country, living costs can vary hugely between cities and rural areas.
vary.zh: 即使在同一个国家内，城市和农村地区的生活成本也可能差异巨大。

vary.en: Milgram was shaken. He repeated the experiment multiple times, varying the conditions.
vary.zh: 米尔格拉姆本人也被震撼到了。他多次重复这项实验，并不断改变实验条件。

valley.en: I asked what the Egyptologist Howard Carter discovered in the Valley of the Kings in 1922.
valley.zh: 我问的是埃及学家霍华德·卡特于1922年在帝王谷发现了什么。

valley.en: Around the 14th century, the Aztecs migrated into the Valley of Mexico.
valley.zh: 大约在14世纪，阿兹特克人迁徙到了墨西哥谷。

valley.en: I remember 15 years ago when Silicon Valley seemed a pretty nice place everyone was excited about.
valley.zh: 我记得十五年前，硅谷看起来还是个挺不错的地方，大家都对它充满期待。

valley.en: And in this situation, tech bros, young men working in the tech industry, often in Silicon Valley.
valley.zh: 在这种情况下，则是科技兄弟（tech bros），也就是在科技行业工作、通常在硅谷的年轻男性。

valley.en: Trade was a major part of life in the Indus Valley.
valley.zh: 贸易是印度河流域生活的主要部分。

variation.en: A take on something means a variation, or new way of presenting it.
variation.zh: 对某事的一种 a take on something 意味着一种变种，或者是展礰它的新方式。

variation.en: For example, the shalpuborgari, or shop burger, was a take on – or variation of – the American hamburger.
variation.zh: 例如，shalpuborgari，或者叫店锯汉堡，就是对美式汉堡的一种改编或变种。

variation.en: That said, I would argue that once you figure it out for yourself, you can kind of carve these variations on these maxims that apply to you.
variation.zh: 话虽如此，我会说一旦你自己弄明白了，你就可以雕琢出适用于你自己的这些格言的变体。

variation.en: These are all variations of the same point: First Past the Post rewards parties that can win lots of constituencies, not necessarily lots of votes.
variation.zh: 这些都是同一个观点的不同变体：“得票最多者当选”奖励那些能够赢得大量选区的政党，而不一定是赢得大量选票的政党。

variation.en: Most of your DNA is identical with every other person on earth, and it's only the tiny amount of difference that accounts for all genetic variations between humans.
variation.zh: 你绝大部分的DNA与地球上的其他每个人都是相同的，只有极少量的差异构成了人与人之间的所有基因变异。

vast.en: That means humans lived without written language for the vast majority of our existence.
vast.zh: 这意味着人类在绝大多数生存时期里都没有书面语言。

vast.en: In a matter of months, the rebels had captured vast swathes of the country.
vast.zh: 短短几个月内，叛军就攻占了大片国土。

vast.en: The vast majority of children, 85%, that's how many in this country attend traditional public schools.
vast.zh: 绝大多数儿童，即85%，这个国家有这么多比例的学生就读于传统公立学校。

vast.en: Suddenly, this vast swathe of territory in the Middle East was the enemy.
vast.zh: 突然之间，中东这片广袤的土地成了敌占区。

vast.en: They settled on islands that were separated by vast distances of open water.
vast.zh: 他们在被广阔开阔水域隔开的岛屿上定居。

valuable.en: Politicians might accept a bribe from companies hoping to gain access to valuable resources.
valuable.zh: 政客可能会接受希望获得宝贵资源准入的公司的贿赂。

valuable.en: It’s the idea that we can mine valuable minerals not from Earth, but from space.
valuable.zh: 这个概念指的是，我们开采珍贵矿产不是从地球上开采，而是从太空中获取。

valuable.en: However, modern astronomers believe 16 Psyche to be immeasurably more valuable than was first thought.
valuable.zh: 然而，现代天文学家认为，16 Psyche 的价值比最初想象的要不可估量得多。

valuable.en: These were very valuable things. These plantations relied heavily on African slaves.
valuable.zh: 这些是非常有价值的东西。这些种植园严重依赖非洲奴隶。

valuable.en: From an evolutionary perspective, this is why confidence has been so valuable.
valuable.zh: 从进化的角度来看，这就是为什么自信如此宝贵。

vacant.en: The four of them walked toward the vacant lot where they had heard the Cowboys were.
vacant.zh: 四人朝着据说“牛仔帮”所在的那块空地走去。

vacant.en: In a narrow vacant lot beside a photography studio in Tombstone, Arizona, eight men are standing close together.
vacant.zh: 在亚利桑那州汤姆斯通(Tombstone)一家照相馆旁边的一块狭窄空地上，八名男子紧紧站在一起。

vacant.en: A by-election is a special election held to fill a parliamentary seat that becomes vacant, empty, between general elections.
vacant.zh: 补选是为了填补在两次大选之间空缺的议会席位而特别举行的选举。

vacant.en: This amendment also allowed Presidents to fill the Vice Presidency if it became vacant, which added further importance to the role and established it as a clear second-in-command rather than just an afterthought.
vacant.zh: 这项修正案还允许总统在副总统职位空缺时进行任命，这进一步提升了副总统的作用，确立了其明确的二把手地位，而不再仅仅是个无足轻重的附庸。

vacuum.en: And, so, going from the vacuum tube to the transistor was one of these discontinuities.
vacuum.zh: 所以，从真空管过渡到晶体管，正是这样一种断层式的跃迁。

vacuum.en: I talked to James Dyson, the guy that invented the vacuum cleaner guy.
vacuum.zh: 我和 James Dyson 聊过，就是发明吸尘器的那个人。

vacuum.en: What actually happened, though, was less a smooth technocratic transition and more a chaotic power vacuum.
vacuum.zh: 然而，实际发生的情况与其说是一个平稳的技术官僚过渡，不如说是一个混乱的权力真空。

vacuum.en: She vacuums, mops, smaller stuff too. We're house detailers.
vacuum.zh: 她吸尘、拖地，也做一些小活。我们是房屋细节清理工。

vague.en: Vague questions lead to vague answers; clear questions lead to useful ones.
vague.zh: 模糊的问题导致模糊的答案；清晰的问题带来有用的答案。

vague.en: Vague questions lead to vague answers; clear questions lead to useful ones.
vague.zh: 模糊的问题导致模糊的答案；清晰的问题带来有用的答案。

vague.en: Instead of vague resolutions like, “I want to get better at English”, try something more concrete, something more specific.
vague.zh: 不要设定诸如“我想提高英语水平”这样模糊的决心，试着制定更具体、更明确的目标。

vague.en: Exactly. Yeah. It's vague and it's fuzzy.
vague.zh: 没错。对，这既模糊又抽象。

vague.en: This wasn’t a goal I set publicly last year, but it has been something that I have been setting as a vague goal every year for about 13 years now.
vague.zh: 这不是我去年公开设定的目标，但大约 13 年来，它一直是我每年都在敷衍地设定一下的模糊目标。

vanity.en: “All men dream, but not equally. Those who dream by night in the dusty recesses of their minds wake up in the day to find it was vanity, but the dreamers of the day are dangerous men, for they may act their dreams with open eyes, to make it possible.”
vanity.zh: “所有人都会做梦，但各不相同。那些在夜晚、在脑海幽暗角落做梦的人，白天醒来发现那只是虚幻；但那些在白天做梦的人是危险的，因为他们会睁着眼睛去实践梦想，使其成为可能。”

vain.en: And, in a sense, Fawcett’s obsession may not have been in vain.
vain.zh: 从某种意义上说，Fawcett 的执念或许并非徒劳。

validity.en: First of all, many people have questioned the scientific validity of the experiment.
validity.zh: 首先，很多人质疑这项实验在科学上的有效性。

validity.en: He said, but this was a miracle. He said, this shouldn't have happened like this. and then my mom was like yeah of course of course it's a miracle and of course this is how it was going to happen she's like you know my my lord protects me so he didn't go to prison no no he didn't how how does how does that so in south africa um i don't think it's unique to south africa as well you know i've when i've traveled to other african countries i've learned this is unfortunately true the crime that a man commits against his wife or his partner isn't given the same validity as if it were committed against a stranger.
validity.zh: 他说，但这确实是一个奇迹。他说，这不应该这样发生。然后我妈妈说，是的，当然，当然这是一个奇迹，当然事情会这样发生。她说，你知道，我的主保护我。所以他没有坐牢？不，不，他没有。这怎么，怎么会这样？在南非，嗯，我不认为这在南非是独一无二的，你知道，当我前往其他非洲国家时，我了解到这不幸是事实，一个男人对他妻子或伴侣犯下的罪行，并不像对陌生人犯下罪行那样具有同样的有效性。

vapour.en: Nuclear power stations would have no ugly black smoke coming out of the top, there would be no dusty coal trucks driving in and out of the plant every day, there would just be harmless water vapour coming out of a large chimney.
vapour.zh: 核电站顶部不会冒出难看的黑烟，没有满载灰尘的运煤卡车每天进出电厂，高大的烟囱里只会冒出无害的水蒸气。

variable.en: The more useful variable, according to research, is how much meaningful participation each student gets.
variable.zh: 根据研究，更有用的变量是每个学生能获得多少有意义的参与度。
这就是“通过氛围编程，而不是变量”。

vault.en: But for some reason, you were the guy in the podcast, in podcast in the vault.
vault.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，那我就去录一次吧。

vault.en: And the reason is a really funny one. It's because when I am playing podcasts in the vault in my head, for some reason you're on the other side.
vault.zh: 我不知道为什么。我真的不知道为什么。

vase.en: And what happens is you break a plate or you break a vase or something.
vase.zh: 当你打碎了一个盘子或一个花瓶之类的东西时，会发生什么呢？

vacation.en: Glen had five cars, a $1.5 million vacation house in Connecticut, and a penthouse that he rented in Manhattan.
vacation.zh: Glen 拥有五辆汽车、价值 150 万美元的康涅狄格州度假屋，以及他在曼哈顿租的一套顶层公寓。

vacation.en: I visited her during summer vacation at her house in Grand Rapids.
vacation.zh: 暑假期间，我在她位于大急流城的家中拜访了她。

vacation.en: You only date within your religion. But again, I was like, I'm just taking a vacation from all of that stress.
vacation.zh: 你只能在你的宗教内部约会。但话又说回来，我想，我只是在摆脱所有那些压力，给自己放个假。

vacation.en: Stay present with your family. Take a vacation.
vacation.zh: 与家人保持当下的连结。去度假。

vacation.en: I'm going to take a vacation from being lonely.

valve.en: It's not a choice. And to me, loneliness and poverty are the forms of scarcity that feel the biggest because while all these forces are at play, there's no release valve.
valve.zh: 这不是一种选择。对我和来说，孤独和贫困是感觉最巨大的两种稀缺形态，因为在所有这些力量交织起作用的时候，并没有一个释放阀。
